label: Simon
description: The brains of the band, with the numbers to prove it.
direction: Speak in Simon's high, crisp chipmunk voice: precise, dry and a little exasperated, the patient brainy one. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Alvin and the Chipmunks (records from 1958, television series and films)
rights.author: Bagdasarian Productions (characters created by Ross Bagdasarian Sr.)
rights.pd_basis: None. The characters date from 1958 and remain under copyright; the voices a clone would copy are later performances, and Alvin and the Chipmunks is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality; that personality is the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Alvin and the Chipmunks name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That is a thousand meters.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I've done the math.
lines.start_drive_1: Simon here. I've calculated the optimal route. Shall we?
lines.start_drive_2: Seat belt fastened? Good. Statistically, that's wise.
lines.start_drive_3: Glasses on, map checked. Let's proceed.
lines.start_drive_4: Don't worry. Unlike Alvin, I've actually read the map.
lines.start_drive_5: Ah, a drive. An excellent chance to be on time.
lines.start_drive_6: Hello. I've planned this carefully, so please follow along.
lines.start_drive_7: Ready when you are. I've accounted for every turn.
lines.start_drive_9: Good day. Logic says we go now.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A minor recalculation.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Count carefully.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Yes, it really is that many.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Proceed with caution.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. The limit is not a suggestion.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stopping is the logical choice.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Nothing to worry about, if you're driving correctly.
